description.value: Ridge Brewing Company opened in July 2015 as one of the first craft breweries in Maple Ridge, BC, and operates a tasting room offering flights, growler fills, cans, kegs, and merchandise. With a 10 HL brewhouse and year-round new releases, it anchors the Maple Ridge Ale Trail — a scenic cycling route through a forested community set between Golden Ears Mountains and the Fraser River. Monthly events including crib tournaments, trivia, and live music give it a strong community character.
